**Morning Recovery** by More Labs is a 3.4-ounce pre-drinking shot designed to support liver function, break down alcohol toxins, and reduce next-day hangover symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1-PWh9qe2ye364x_lWqtz7HzD4-ZgQL4lJ6CcE_Ua-rJavESzTUkz6nhjRIBZYaxSkPiKgh0eNfgvcxJWhSl-ls7KUa_MX2GETeCslf94Z4ZHSeG4eA9H2PGOch8gJRmZbeotwnCt7i7A3VOPhtEaDo5X7GEu6jg5Ibc_7celE_zGL4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXCrbcuW3vKyabk5zD3-Ww9onCrgW2NLoJR7_x4ymabl7VjKewYysK78chmyvjCC8MMMt9drR7fqtvsAf4Blt9t_nap8MncjtriMs33kFK7oHrljcdhvxZjSRU1rbQlr15sQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDPsB3k69OT66IMYyuZSjqsfuXqlsgjiRvjAluC0fXbMdg7ID67fSo601kESXMMEfj8sN8b0erM-LQgfn8eNw7t-N5nvhJwvomgGPwfavtJbA99E5N845zl_Saz1gcb0Naj249oNHGElVz63fsxP_DQ-zRu1b)

### Key Ingredients

- **DHM (Hovenia Dulcis Extract):** Derived from the Japanese raisin tree, it helps the liver break down alcohol toxins more efficiently.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXCrbcuW3vKyabk5zD3-Ww9onCrgW2NLoJR7_x4ymabl7VjKewYysK78chmyvjCC8MMMt9drR7fqtvsAf4Blt9t_nap8MncjtriMs33kFK7oHrljcdhvxZjSRU1rbQlr15sQ)
- **Milk Thistle (Silymarin):** Provides antioxidant support to the liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXuX6tayKHWn8Z6hsfdOF09_4SSRMGpUt1NC11mXvWSJFPNKqM8M6M5MLQmwMj5HaKBN_jtr9iCahZnwPE0ty7bCkTQfGxL_jImr_BXJJr07-7HJKi1AwY3euwHRBH1mpKyWYG5w7GBdFMmt2FUm9-qHb5W_cmtI16REg)
- **Korean Pear & Prickly Pear Extracts:** Traditionally used to ease inflammation and alcohol-related stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1-PWh9qe2ye364x_lWqtz7HzD4-ZgQL4lJ6CcE_Ua-rJavESzTUkz6nhjRIBZYaxSkPiKgh0eNfgvcxJWhSl-ls7KUa_MX2GETeCslf94Z4ZHSeG4eA9H2PGOch8gJRmZbeotwnCt7i7A3VOPhtEaDo5X7GEu6jg5Ibc_7celE_zGL4)
- **B & C Vitamins and Electrolytes:** Replenishes vital nutrients and aids energy metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXuX6tayKHWn8Z6hsfdOF09_4SSRMGpUt1NC11mXvWSJFPNKqM8M6M5MLQmwMj5HaKBN_jtr9iCahZnwPE0ty7bCkTQfGxL_jImr_BXJJr07-7HJKi1AwY3euwHRBH1mpKyWYG5w7GBdFMmt2FUm9-qHb5W_cmtI16REg)

### Versions & Options

- **Original Version:** Contains cane sugar (~80 calories) with a smooth citrus taste.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXuX6tayKHWn8Z6hsfdOF09_4SSRMGpUt1NC11mXvWSJFPNKqM8M6M5MLQmwMj5HaKBN_jtr9iCahZnwPE0ty7bCkTQfGxL_jImr_BXJJr07-7HJKi1AwY3euwHRBH1mpKyWYG5w7GBdFMmt2FUm9-qHb5W_cmtI16REg)
- **Sugar-Free Version:** Sweetened with stevia and erythritol (~5 calories) for low-carb or keto lifestyles.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXuX6tayKHWn8Z6hsfdOF09_4SSRMGpUt1NC11mXvWSJFPNKqM8M6M5MLQmwMj5HaKBN_jtr9iCahZnwPE0ty7bCkTQfGxL_jImr_BXJJr07-7HJKi1AwY3euwHRBH1mpKyWYG5w7GBdFMmt2FUm9-qHb5W_cmtI16REg)
- **Flavors:** Available in regular lemon, lemon ginger, and sugar-free options.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX1QPgbr6Eg7nDLRAeNh6n3XIjbKW04CXv_8MhZBoRBI8lVKupiX_1hIY70MpYl7YOeIkUPtoMA6ayRQPVi5mKGrbhURxDqiMzdrD5pxqCJucgDswvokQQoh5DNzsCxvDwjZUCi8lI)

### How to Use

- **Timing:** Drink one bottle right before your first alcoholic drink, while drinking, or up to an hour after your last drink.
- **Limit:** Do not exceed two bottles per day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXygSgzIkia9EUUOhwn6uMvrVnHugPk3-PwrpGM7wa5WxXWilPHPWy_s9qsIw3F_wo3cpU6GLPpLVlpyhVxsPYkidZDXyaA5bzdfAPBFefI0k16hIxJ7El-Ok1Mlu5AByJKZltWPMjYQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX0EY7J_0pL_TuaIV-IYNdN1f0v39eYWnGHP9Qq7f75t6DqfVpbvN1Vm93uRK3HMBGqCY-gCGUMpL4IghHPMCxyaO-QID_Rh-upwHzYeHqoqMxGkSMwab8BxdIBqSNLWFlphQsa-E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDPsB3k69OT66IMYyuZSjqsfuXqlsgjiRvjAluC0fXbMdg7ID67fSo601kESXMMEfj8sN8b0erM-LQgfn8eNw7t-N5nvhJwvomgGPwfavtJbA99E5N845zl_Saz1gcb0Naj249oNHGElVz63fsxP_DQ-zRu1b)

### User Reviews & Effectiveness

- **What Users Say:** Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF1_bZjZQVvvFclCOOSLrQFoPai1Fvip8QGHw2lFya8ADl2cw6YmXiGEArEflFqEPZH06X48-csuEFb7O1rgP-An7ildx38iIFgao-laLzrlNA67xHyyrpTR9jemH654zZ27prDbQvHJ2dbZ-N1qYCXftMNltZJnde-WXxw0meidL4RRTOMWTxBOA_OqH-RzdbsWIIIzyvnB2SPNjDbsEl) report a consensus that Morning Recovery helps lessen severe symptoms like nausea, pounding headaches, and morning grogginess. However, results vary; some users still experience mild fatigue or minor headaches depending on how much alcohol was consumed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3tGoJkr6gRR8l3MEozahnoaxUqlgEJ7BeWc1xMO5zOb1OKQjrc8IhKidhFNLpVRA4aGAcwo28iJGX-0m41tUwztdE1rRCbUQf348zmy4QaLMr2z3IkIbxaJ7LDcu1jLPg9lRaly4VRo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESowEBxCJF1_bZjZQVvvFclCOOSLrQFoPai1Fvip8QGHw2lFya8ADl2cw6YmXiGEArEflFqEPZH06X48-csuEFb7O1rgP-An7ildx38iIFgao-laLzrlNA67xHyyrpTR9jemH654zZ27prDbQvHJ2dbZ-N1qYCXftMNltZJnde-WXxw0meidL4RRTOMWTxBOA_OqH-RzdbsWIIIzyvnB2SPNjDbsEl)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX1QPgbr6Eg7nDLRAeNh6n3XIjbKW04CXv_8MhZBoRBI8lVKupiX_1hIY70MpYl7YOeIkUPtoMA6ayRQPVi5mKGrbhURxDqiMzdrD5pxqCJucgDswvokQQoh5DNzsCxvDwjZUCi8lI)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXGciN2zJ9flxEq8JVzhIAeDFBc1d1-pMLbsDWOMF7i6AikWVDG3_C9i6o1oAUEi2hg4IWr57IY9HVyMCMWYGd0oMjsksb3efF4fRt3s-KyNwMV1oJZ-31Ol4_d7zGh3-UMXeT4lKLnQ)
- **Cost:** Retails around $5 per bottle individually, with lower per-unit pricing when buying multi-packs or subscribing through the [More Labs Store](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF105J8pnJkrW1j5HjTXNPRx8Pyq4JEp6MUODba5l_EKU_QbWe33Dj4svukzNaa_CWQ02U6NiiILODiPu6rP-XarKqDsbpKTN0pS6YyplteZ51kdOJP380bWrrL4SIFszpmnbB60OEPe-YZ3SAg8NOsNZ1EFMlREvHUkezZiE_ApRQBaIQPdlEpGzGYGR8mdZSlkCNo9Hp0khLg8zTTHmn2KhfIl9IFXlEcxM).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3tGoJkr6gRR8l3MEozahnoaxUqlgEJ7BeWc1xMO5zOb1OKQjrc8IhKidhFNLpVRA4aGAcwo28iJGX-0m41tUwztdE1rRCbUQf348zmy4QaLMr2z3IkIbxaJ7LDcu1jLPg9lRaly4VRo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXrqFnMkmYnrt99Qcn38q6TcA7MN59uZJAgYEE1k2k8zflfNmxZMzPTVFBNlS_rJhcOn_eQLOPVSmCKwU6GhH8ybg9W1nupuDxDPMMmqAHFwBo3XXW56n8JYMO-m1GVLJv2A)
- **Scientific Note:** While individual active components like DHM and Korean red ginseng show promise in preliminary studies for alcohol metabolism, comprehensive clinical data on commercial hangover drinks remains limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXSG7H9t2Legl3ya3H5JjIh_Fo5UZXgbzFsGgjg3e5u5whJUPoYD4eSI-KO4BDM8qq326PLjuXfpU-pHXkZtxPpBp2wedjkYeiF516xeyGb1w2-kD-uvysYszM8IOjHPzEOA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXgYU7mi2OCMOX9Q0qstlxC0kJNG00As1qeO4DTCeNG246zEL9tqKi0czcpYeuUYUUUCLZzGjkaahRR7hR6Kk75h9QG0W5YPwi-_Y-yriYPdE2PfKToIXBCOSmiIujtHfbg9KxmPKnRQ)

If you're considering trying it out, let me know:

- **How many drinks** you typically have in a night
- Whether you prefer **sugar-free or regular** 
- Any specific symptoms (like **headaches or nausea** ) you want to prevent most

- **Cost:** Retails around $5 per bottle individually, with lower per-unit pricing when buying multi-packs or subscribing through the [More Labs Store](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF105J8pnJkrW1j5HjTXNPRx8Pyq4JEp6MUODba5l_EKU_QbWe33Dj4svukzNaa_CWQ02U6NiiILODiPu6rP-XarKqDsbpKTN0pS6YyplteZ51kdOJP380bWrrL4SIFszpmnbB60OEPe-YZ3SAg8NOsNZ1EFMlREvHUkezZiE_ApRQBaIQPdlEpGzGYGR8mdZSlkCNo9Hp0khLg8zTTHmn2KhfIl9IFXlEcxM).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3tGoJkr6gRR8l3MEozahnoaxUqlgEJ7BeWc1xMO5zOb1OKQjrc8IhKidhFNLpVRA4aGAcwo28iJGX-0m41tUwztdE1rRCbUQf348zmy4QaLMr2z3IkIbxaJ7LDcu1jLPg9lRaly4VRo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXrqFnMkmYnrt99Qcn38q6TcA7MN59uZJAgYEE1k2k8zflfNmxZMzPTVFBNlS_rJhcOn_eQLOPVSmCKwU6GhH8ybg9W1nupuDxDPMMmqAHFwBo3XXW56n8JYMO-m1GVLJv2A)
- **Scientific Note:** While individual active components like DHM and Korean red ginseng show promise in preliminary studies for alcohol metabolism, comprehensive clinical data on commercial hangover drinks remains limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXSG7H9t2Legl3ya3H5JjIh_Fo5UZXgbzFsGgjg3e5u5whJUPoYD4eSI-KO4BDM8qq326PLjuXfpU-pHXkZtxPpBp2wedjkYeiF516xeyGb1w2-kD-uvysYszM8IOjHPzEOA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXgYU7mi2OCMOX9Q0qstlxC0kJNG00As1qeO4DTCeNG246zEL9tqKi0czcpYeuUYUUUCLZzGjkaahRR7hR6Kk75h9QG0W5YPwi-_Y-yriYPdE2PfKToIXBCOSmiIujtHfbg9KxmPKnRQ)
